name: Steroids
text: +5 overall for one game. Cheap, but 51% chance of being caught: suspended for 10 games or the rest of the season, whichever is longer. Use it too often unnoticed and the rumours start.

name: Ice Bath

name: Flowers
text: Bring them on your next Date: a much better evening (+8 love life on top). Used up on the date.

name: Pre-workout
text: A much better Train hard: about 75% more progress and a skill point every session. Costs a little extra energy. Season cap still applies.
